highlights_led_by_exploit_ready_vulns: CISA gives agencies 3 days to patch maximum severity Ivanti vulnerability and GreatXML zero-day BitLocker bypass doesn’t seem to work, yet. Treat newly published PoCs and early exploitation signals as immediate patch/mitigation triggers for internet-facing and fleet-wide infrastructure.
endpoint_posture_under_pressure: China-nexus group hid in Linux login system for nearly a decade. Tighten EDR coverage, block known IoCs where available, and validate software supply-chain integrity in build and CI/CD.
identity_and_edge_access_risks: Novo Nordisk discloses data breach affecting patient and healthcare professional information. Prioritize MFA enforcement, phishing-resistant authentication, and reduce management-plane exposure for edge services and remote access.
